title: Find the image a design replaced
responsibility: Finds a supported before-image for a design shown at the commit that introduced it.

inputs.name: priorImage.versions
inputs.description: The ordered design history searched for the displayed version. A prior image requires that version's commit to equal the selected commit; without revises, fallback pairing uses only the immediately preceding version and only when the shown version has no options.

examples.prompt: Set the header image to a coastal view.

inputs.name: priorImage.shown
inputs.description: The displayed version identifier and optional selected image used by the lookup. A prior image can be returned only when image is defined; its viewport and state select the corresponding image from the preceding version in the single-design fallback.

inputs.name: priorImage.commit
inputs.description: The commit selected in the commit view; it must exactly equal the matching design version's commit. Null denotes a branch view and causes the function to return null.

outputs.name: priorImage
outputs.description: The exact image named by the version's revises binding when present; otherwise, only a version without options can use the preceding version's image with the same viewport and state. It is null when the commit, image, matching version, or eligible prior image is missing.
